summary: Adds the different-major agent guide, split out from the deleted agentic-upgrade.mdx. The duplicate check and commit/delivery steps move to shared.md, and the guide now covers only checklist, codemod run, repair, verify and a hand-off to shared.md. The CLI copies this file into the agent's run directory and prompts the agent to follow it, so its wording directly steers what the agent does to a user's repository.
headline: New different-major agentic upgrade guide split from the old single guide
reason: Docs-only, but this text is shipped to an agent as executable instructions that drive edits in user repositories, so wording changes alter runtime behavior.
risk_signals: agent instructions bundled and executed at runtime
relative paths to shared.md and ../codemods.md must match the CLI copy layout
focus: Relative links ../codemods.md and ../version-<major>.md resolve to the files next-upgrade.ts copies into the run directory, including 02-pages for majors below 14
Dropping the duplicate-check and commit steps here is covered by shared.md, which the prompt tells the agent to read first
The 'rerun that command once' security-gate wording is unchanged from the old guide and still intended
